summary: Closed the last open point with a receipt. Receipt a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d (exit 0, thirty events) resolves the agreement comparison as violated at witness event index 27: eight seconds after the partition healed, the isolated node and the majority-side leader hold different entries at the same log index while the same event records both writes acknowledged and neither node applied an entry absent from its own log; the flag-off control's two sides agree at their index (comparison 1 holds, evaluated index 29). Combined with the short-window negative (receipt 4e9eaa72cf594018b8414a8d8efb7cb3, all comparisons holding at two seconds), the answer is that the acknowledged entries are not lost from either log but the two replicas permanently disagree at that index, each keeping the write its own client was told had succeeded. The question now carries five complete violated comparisons with controls — configuration loss (15/18), minority election (22/25), single-side acknowledgement (27/29), two-sided acknowledgement (27/29) and post-heal log disagreement (27/29) — plus one bounded negative; the interpretation is updated to cover them with joint history across the six executions, a Behavior knowledge entry is promoted for the post-heal disagreement, and the registered gap is answered resolved=true: election and acknowledgement resolved by complete comparisons, divergence witnessed, with the caveat that the compared entry payloads are emitted only as a derived boolean and that every window remains bounded.
